Turkish or Syrian Coffee

$6.95

A finely ground medium roast coffee prepared with no filter method, it is heated in the Turkish Coffee kettle machine until it boils and pours into a cup. Usually served with something sweet, like baklava or dates. Turkish coffee has no Cardamom added (Syrian coffee has Cardamom).
